direction: About 12 s. Wide closing still with a slow pull-back. The ox cart, loaded with sheaves, creaks up the track towards the brow with the couple walking beside it. The smoke from beyond the crest drifts in the wind; the stone house stays out of frame. Cloud rolls up over the marshes and the river below. Ambience: cart wheels, oxen, geese, the first drops of rain.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 cinematic wide still, Roman-period Britain c. AD 200. A wooden ox cart piled with golden spelt sheaves is pulled up an earth track towards the crest of an inland hill by two oxen. A man and a woman in wool clothing walk beside it, seen small from behind. A thin line of smoke rises beyond the crest with no building visible. Below, a winding river and marshland under rolling grey cloud, distant estuary haze. No sea, no coastline. Moody late-afternoon light. No text, no heraldry.
